name: AiryBotCode
tagline: Discord bot fleet with a control panel
description: Discord bot fleet with a Vue control panel and an ASP.NET API. Its compose project also carries the shared Postgres and the prod Caddy that serves The Hive.

prod.start: docker compose -p airybotcode -f docker-compose.yml up -d --no-build --no-deps api caddy (the bot airydevbot is off by the owner's decision since 2026-10-21; start it by name only when the owner says so)
prod.deploy: ./scripts/airy-deploy.sh prod (main only: builds the api and caddy images, recreates the api service alone, copies the panel files into the running Caddy; never airydevbot, never airy-postgres-db, never restarts Caddy)
prod.db: airy-postgres-db/airy_db (the shared Postgres: every app's database lives here); the panel API uses its own role airybotcode_app (airy_db.public only), sign-in on evil_users (role evil_users_airy)
prod.notes: airy.thatevilguy.com (tunnel route to :8088) serves the panel (AiryPanel, built into the Caddy image and copied into the running one on deploy) and /api (the API on the Evil SDK under the path base /api; sign-in with the Evil account, only people with an airybotcode grant get in). Discord sign-in is built but off until the owner adds https://airy.thatevilguy.com/api/auth/external/discord/callback in the Discord developer portal and the SDK can open a browser session from it. thehive.thatevilguy.com shows only The Hive. The Caddyfile is a bind mount: after an edit, the next Caddy restart (a maintenance window) picks it up.

dev.branch: feature branches (the dev stack builds the checkout it is started from)
dev.start: ./scripts/airy-deploy.sh dev (db-dev, caddy-dev, api-dev; 127.0.0.1:10000 and 172.17.0.1:10000 for the browser container)
dev.db: db-dev container/airy_db_dev (own Postgres); sign-in on evil_users_dev (role evil_users_dev_airy)
dev.notes: Local only. The API runs in Development (it owns the dev schema there). Checks: scripts/auth-check.mjs (the synthetic dev owner from evil-sdk-data/dev-owner.login), scripts/api-walk.mjs (old build against new on one copy).

tools.start: AiryBotCode.Frontend/AiryPanel: npm run dev (Vite on 172.17.0.1:5173, /api proxied to 127.0.0.1:8202); the API: scripts/panel-dev-api.sh (dotnet run on 127.0.0.1:8202 against the scratch database airy_panel_dev, a copy of prod airy_db, and evil_users_dev)
tools.notes: Panel rebuild loop (docs/panel-rebuild). The scratch database is a restore of the newest prod backup; drop it when the rebuild ships.

flow.promote: Work lands on a feature branch, is checked on the dev stack (./scripts/airy-deploy.sh dev), merged into main and pushed; ./scripts/airy-deploy.sh prod deploys main.
rules: Public repo: appsettings.json, .env and every credential stay out of git; credentials live in /mnt/hdd/projects/AiryBotCode-data (700, files 600).
Never point hooks, OAuth or API calls at the *.ts.net Funnel host.
Docker builds leave root-owned obj/bin: chown before a host dotnet build or test.
Carries the shared Postgres and prod Caddy: never restart them outside a maintenance window; prod deploys recreate the api service only.
The SDK comes from the feed (nuget.config maps Evil.* to /mnt/hdd/projects/evil-sdk-data/feed, Docker builds get it as the evil-feed context); pin the exact version.
